source.description:
## PROBLEM
Upstream xtrm-dev/core canonical templates/skills mandate 'bd prime' at session start and reference legacy service-skills paths. Editing Mercury consumers alone would regress after XTRM refresh. Jira ISSUE-136 Phase A (load-bearing).

## SUCCESS
No canonical generated startup block requires bd prime; targeted Beads discovery + Service Knowledge routing present; agent-docs-maintainer uses service-knowledge naming; evals/tests pass.

## SCOPE
- templates/claude-md-fragments/bd-workflow.md
- .xtrm/config/instructions/agents-top.md
- .xtrm/config/instructions/claude-top.md
- skills/using-xtrm/SKILL.md
- .xtrm/skills/default/using-xtrm/SKILL.md
- .xtrm/skills/default/starting-and-resuming-work/SKILL.md
- .xtrm/skills/default/agent-docs-maintainer/ (SKILL + refs + evals)
- installer/help output presenting bd prime as normal startup
- regression tests/evals for generated startup blocks

## NON_GOALS
- Phase B (service-knowledge package docs) and Phase C (Mercury consumers)
- Removing bd prime command itself; it stays as opt-in diagnostic

## VALIDATION
- grep: no mandatory/automatic bd prime in generated fixtures
- targeted Beads commands documented; AGENTS vs CLAUDE distinct
- SK routing present where applicable; evals/tests pass

## OUTPUT
PR link + Jira ISSUE-136 progress comment.
source.notes: Phase A implementation complete in worktree. 16 files changed: agents-top, claude-top (targeted session-start, SK routing, legacy alias note), bd-workflow fragment 1.0.2->1.1.0, both using-xtrm skills, starting-and-resuming-work + surfaces, using-specialists-auto + registry-and-locations, agent-docs-maintainer SKILL + both templates (SK sections), evals.json (e3 updated + new eval 6 for mandatory-bd-prime), install.ts next-steps, root AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md regenerated content. Validation: V1 no mandatory bd prime (grep empty), V2 targeted Beads present, V3 SK index-query routing present, V4 tops distinct, V5 6 evals; vitest 8/8 pass, pytest 5/5 pass, forbidden-phrases 0 violations, tsc clean. Registry hash churn reverted (pre-existing version drift, unrelated). Remaining: commit + PR + Jira comment.
